subject.title: WhatsApp: Gemini thinking tags (<think>/<final>) still leak after #6328 fix

question: For malformed tagged reasoning that opens `<think>` and later contains a `<final>` block without closing the thinking block, should strict delivery recover only the final content, suppress the payload, or keep the current fallback?
rationale: The current fallback can expose private reasoning, but changing it affects security and message-loss semantics across all channels that use the shared sanitizer, so automation should not choose the boundary without maintainer intent.

options.title: Recover final-only content
options.body: Update the shared sanitizer to prefer the later `<final>` body and drop earlier reasoning when strict mode sees an unclosed thinking tag.

options.title: Fail closed on malformed reasoning
options.body: Suppress the whole malformed payload to avoid leakage, accepting possible empty replies for models that omit closing tags.

options.title: Keep current fallback
options.body: Leave the current recovery behavior in place and accept the residual risk that malformed tagged output can leak private reasoning.

recommendation.title: Recover final-only content
recommendation.body: Update the shared sanitizer to prefer the later `<final>` body and drop earlier reasoning when strict mode sees an unclosed thinking tag.

likelyOwner.reason: He has the strongest current history on the shared reasoning/assistant-visible sanitizer boundary.
